events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place over three days in 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love Echoes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, the Woodstock Festival defined a generation. What's your favourite tune that came from those legendary fields?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy is undeniable – what's the first track you're playing today?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996, passing away on September 13th.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a voice that continues to resonate. Remembering Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Hero Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true innovator. Jimi Hendrix redefined the electric guitar and continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and those legendary tracks – what's your standout moment from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the powerful frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon with a voice that commands attention. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he fronted?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album and its title track remain a powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: The iPod's Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago, it changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, who's your favourite Bond and what's your top 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Monty Python Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered the 'White Album'. So much music, so many stories – what's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Queen song?
